notes.title: Buy a Game, Help Kids Beat Cancer
notes.content:
Aspyr is proud to announce that we, along with several other publishers, have joined forced with Team17 and GOSH -- Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity -- in their efforts to raise money to build a new Children's Care Center at the GOSH Hospital based in London.

As well as being one of the world's leading children's hospitals, the Great Ormond Street Hospital is the largest for children's heart surgery in Britain and one of the largest for heart transplants in the world. Fun fact: the hospital owns the copyright to Peter Pan. Who knew?

GOSH is running the Play it. Build it. Beat it. sale on Steam until 2/24 and Aspyr is donating ːgetreadyː 100% of its proceeds ːgetreadyː from Heads Up sales during this event to the hospital. The other publishers involved have also pledged to donate a portion of their proceeds to this organization. The sale is chock-full of cozy and co-op games, so buy some games to play with your buds. And make them buy games too. Hey, it's for the kids!

Some highlights from the Aspyr team:

 The Cult of the Lamb
 Overcooked series
 Cat Quest
 Little Kitty Big City
 The Past Within 
 Heads Up! Phones Down Edition ːyouwinː

notes.title: New characters blast their way into STAR WARS™: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles™!
notes.content:
The fight for the fate of Naboo intensifies in the upcoming release of STAR WARS: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles, as four new playable characters join the battle—Flame Droid, Rodian, Gungan Guard, and Destroyer Droid. But the excitement doesn't stop there! Even more newly playable characters will be unveiled leading up to the game's launch on January 23rd, 2025.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246209/e6efebff04bac1de64d82377906ea075928ede60.jpg

Each new playable character brings unique skills and tactics to the fight, diversifying the action beyond the classic lightsaber duels:


 Flame Droid: Unleashes scorching flames and explosive attacks, blasting enemies with overwhelming firepower.
 Rodian: A deadly sharpshooter with exceptional agility, picking off foes from afar with pinpoint accuracy.
 Gungan Guard: Armed with trusty spears, this formidable warrior attacks with deadly precision in melee range.
 Destroyer Droid: A heavily armored force of destruction, ready to destroy those who attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246209/4405644c37ae84e4218c57eb91ce63603a89404e.jpg

STAR WARS™: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles™ arrives January 23rd - preorder now!

notes.title: Four New Characters Join the Battle with More on the Way!
notes.content:
The galaxy grows even more exciting in the upcoming release of STAR WARS™ Episode I: Jedi Power Battles, as four new playable characters are set to join the battle—Rifle Droid, Staff Tusken Raider, Ishi Tib, and the Mercenary. And this is just the beginning. Even more new characters will be revealed in the lead-up to the game’s launch on January 23rd, 2025.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246209/3836c0b2eeba9bc14ee61b38a52d26d6bbb4f36a.jpg

Each new addition brings a unique fighting style, expanding gameplay beyond the traditional lightsaber battles fans remember from the classic version:  


 Rifle Droid delivers precise, long-range attacks, turning the tide with every shot.  
 Staff Tusken Raider conquers in close quarters, using his staff to land powerful strikes and jabs.  
 Ishi Tib combines agility and strength for fast-paced melee combat.  
 Mercenary blends brute force with tactical attacks, making him a versatile fighter in any encounter.  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246209/3492e8874f3c73a39f7914a034e6bca429766043.jpg

These characters offer new ways to experience the action, ensuring every battle feels fresh and exciting. And with more surprises on the way, fans can look forward to a steady stream of reveals in the months leading up to launch.

STAR WARS™: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles™ arrives January 23rd -- preorder now!

notes.title: Patch 1 for Star Wars™: Bounty Hunter is now available on all platforms!
notes.content:
Full Changelist:


All Platforms
Addressed a bug where the controller would rumble when Montross uses his jetpack during the Chapter 6 boss fight.
Credits will now properly play after the final cutscene.
Updated the Controls Screen to correctly display "Free Aim" instead of "First Person Mode."
Fixed a crash that occurred after acquiring the jetpack for the first time.
Improved camera focus for smoother vertical movement on controller.
Adjusted default audio settings for a better experience.
Updated parental control values to align with PEGI 16 rating for specific regions.
Added new cheat codes that alter the number of continues in the game.

Xbox
Fixed a crash when viewing Concept Art #82.
Fixed an issue where the "A Legend is Born" achievement wasn’t unlocked after completing all other achievements.

Steam
Resolved an issue with GPUs not being identified correctly.
